summary: Iter 10 BETA production-readiness pass (both backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS covering register+login regression, demo-login (kauri), account deletion (DELETE /api/users/me → 200 for regular user + old login blocked with 401; demo account = 403 'Demo accounts cannot be deleted'; unauth = 401), block hides target from /api/nearby, POST /api/reports, plan/radius clamp (free 50m, pro 500m, hard cap 500m). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): fresh session on /login has NO 'Use Demo Account' button (login-demo hidden per useTestMode gate) — PASS. 7-tap on 'Intro v1.0.0' (testID app-version) fires 'Test mode enabled' native alert and sets localStorage intro_test_mode='1' — PASS. After enabling test mode, Profile shows the 'Test & Trial Tools' section with menu-admin, menu-metrics, menu-trial-report, menu-launch-checklist, and disable-test-mode all visible — PASS. delete-account-btn is rendered below Log Out on Profile for a freshly registered user, tapping it fires the web window.confirm dialog with exact copy 'Delete your account? This permanently deletes your profile, pings, matches and meetup history. This can't be undone.' — the confirm→delete→signOut→router.replace('/(auth)/onboarding') path is covered by the corresponding backend test which verified the actual deletion + subsequent login block. FOUND BUG: In public (non-test) mode, the Profile MENU array (top public menu) still contains 'Demo Accounts' (menu-demo-accounts) and 'Trial Mode' (menu-trial) rows — they leak to every logged-in regular user. The other four demo tools (Admin, Metrics, Trial Report, Launch Checklist) are correctly hidden. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx lines 25 (Trial Mode) and 27 (Demo Accounts) — those entries need to be removed from the public MENU const; they already exist in DEMO_MENU (lines 42-43) and are shown under 'Test & Trial Tools' when test mode is on. PRIVACY OBSERVATION: /api/nearby response still contains raw 'lat' and 'lng' fields for every user (server.py line 888-889 in compute_nearby). For demo users these are synthesised via destination_point(requester_lat, requester_lng, demo_dist, demo_bearing) so they're not real positions, BUT for any real (non-demo) user the field maps directly to o['lat']/o['lng'] i.e. their exact stored coordinates. Distance ('About Nm away') is correctly fuzzed in the preview UI (verified iter_9) so end-users don't see it, but the raw API leaks it. Recommendation: strip lat/lng from the nearby serialiser OR replace with fuzzed values before real-user beta launch. Distances/no addresses/street: PASS. Push notifications remain intentionally MOCKED (in-app pings only) per user decision — NOT flagged as a bug. No red screens, no crashes; only carry-over shadow*→boxShadow deprecation warnings from theme.ts.

minor.issue: Response still exposes exact 'lat' and 'lng' fields for every user (compute_nearby, server.py line 888-889). Demo users get synthesised positions so it's benign for the current demo cohort, but real (non-demo) users would leak their true stored coordinates. Beta requirement says '/api/nearby response ... never expose other users' exact lat/lng'. Recommend: remove those fields from the serialiser (or fuzz them) and let the frontend plot markers from distance+bearing instead.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Demo Accounts' (menu-demo-accounts) and 'Trial Mode' (menu-trial) rows are still in the public MENU array and are visible to every regular (non-test-mode) user. They should live only under the 'Test & Trial Tools' section (DEMO_MENU). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx lines 25 and 27 — remove those two entries from MENU; they already exist in DEMO_MENU (lines 42-43) so no duplication is needed.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter 5–9: Expo Web console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' Cosmetic only, no functional impact. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts.

action_items: Remove 'Demo Accounts' and 'Trial Mode' entries from the public MENU const in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx (lines 25 and 27). They must only appear in the DEMO_MENU section rendered under `{testMode && (...)}` (already present at lines 42-43). Verify by loading Profile as a freshly registered non-demo user and confirming those two rows are gone unless test mode is unlocked.

Strip or fuzz `lat` and `lng` on /api/nearby responses (server.py compute_nearby, line 878-895). For real users these currently expose exact stored coordinates. If the radar needs positional data, keep only `distance` + `bearing` and let the frontend project synthetic screen coords from those.
OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter 5-9): migrate deprecated shadow* style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to boxShadow to silence Expo Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx: MENU (lines 16-28) mixes public rows with demo-only rows. Result: 'Trial Mode' and 'Demo Accounts' render for every user regardless of test-mode. The DEMO_MENU (lines 41-48) already re-declares the same two rows for the gated section, so simply removing them from MENU keeps behaviour intact when test mode IS on and hides them when it is off.

profile.tsx onDeleteAccount (lines 76-104) correctly guards is_demo (shows friendly alert), then calls DELETE /users/me via api(), awaits signOut, and router.replace('/(auth)/onboarding'). Web uses window.confirm — Playwright must page.on('dialog', d.accept()). Verified the confirm dialog fires with correct copy.

server.py delete_account (lines 525-539) is idempotent-safe and cascades to pings/matches/meetups/saved/blocks/hides. Correctly returns 403 for demo accounts. Reports are intentionally retained (moderation audit) — this is documented in the code comment.

testMode.ts (lines 8-31): getTestMode reads AsyncStorage key 'intro_test_mode'; on web AsyncStorage falls back to localStorage. Playwright can enable by localStorage.setItem('intro_test_mode','1') + reload. Verified.
login.tsx line 111-119: SecondaryButton for 'Use Demo Account' is wrapped in `{testMode && (...)}` — correctly hidden on fresh sessions.
compute_nearby (server.py 820-905) still emits lat/lng — see minor backend issue above.

success_rate.backend: 11/11 (100%) — register+login, demo-login, delete regular user (+ login-401 after delete), delete demo (403), delete unauth (401), block hides from nearby, POST /reports, free radius clamped to 50m, pro radius=500 accepted, radius=10000 clamped to <=500, /nearby returns coarse distance (with lat/lng caveat above).
success_rate.frontend: 8/9 verified — PASS: login-demo hidden on fresh session, admin/metrics/trial-report/launch-checklist hidden in public menu, test-mode unlock (7-tap → alert + localStorage flag), Test & Trial Tools section appears with all 6 rows + disable-test-mode, delete-account-btn renders + confirm dialog fires with correct copy, register+setup flow reaches profile-setup+, no red screens/crashes on Profile navigation. FAIL: menu-demo-accounts + menu-trial LEAK to public users (Profile MENU array bug).

seed_data_creation: Created 3 test users via /api/auth/register (email pattern TEST_iter10_*@example.com and iter10*@example.com, password Intro123!). One was deleted as part of test_delete_regular_user. The other two are lightweight and won't be discoverable in demo radar (their city defaults to Melbourne with visible=false initially).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test the fix for the MENU leak by: (1) clear localStorage; (2) register a new @example.com user (age 25) — .test/.demo TLDs are still rejected by the email validator; (3) navigate to /profile; (4) assert query_selector('[data-testid="menu-demo-accounts"]') and query_selector('[data-testid="menu-trial"]') both return None. Then to verify test mode re-enables them: page.evaluate("() => localStorage.setItem('intro_test_mode','1')") + page.reload() — both testIDs should appear again inside the 'Test & Trial Tools' section along with menu-admin/menu-metrics/menu-trial-report/menu-launch-checklist/disable-test-mode. Auth response uses `access_token` (not `token`) — the older iterations of backend_test.py used a different key and would fail; the new /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_beta_readiness.py has the correct field. /api/nearby requires ?lat=..&lng=.. query params (422 otherwise) and returns {count, radius, my_vibe, users:[…]}. window.confirm() is used for showAlert() with buttons — always attach page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) BEFORE navigating.
rca_of_issue: menu-demo-accounts + menu-trial leak: the two entries were added to the public MENU array (profile.tsx lines 25, 27) at some point and never removed when DEMO_MENU was introduced. Because both arrays are iterated unconditionally except that DEMO_MENU is wrapped in `{testMode && (...)}`, the public MENU rows always render. Fix: delete the two lines from the MENU const. Reproduction: (1) clear localStorage; (2) register a new user via /register (needs @example.com or similar real TLD); (3) navigate to /profile — Demo Accounts and Trial Mode rows are visible in the top public menu even though they should only be part of the Test & Trial Tools section.
